race.description: You Are Not Alone Midway Hcp (Bm64)
race.comment: DUKE OF ARRAKIS (1) has had two runs back from almost a year off the scene and is struggling a bit. Raced handy but couldn't let down last start over this distance at Rosehill. Has raced three times at stakes level from seven starts so Gai and Adrian see something in him. Finds a weak BM64 today so he can bounce back. SUPERATA (3) was most impressive two back over this trip at Nowra but was less effective in a similar race to this at Kembla last time. Won here at 1400m last prep. Big chance to bounce back to form in a modest affair. CHAPPY (2) raced keenly and dropped right out when resuming over this distance at Rosehill recently. Generally reliable so put that one down to being too fresh. Can atone. FITZCLARENCE (6) found 1200m a bit slick when resuming at Kembla last start. Lightly raced four-year-old who needs this trip now. Last start Newcastle maiden winner
